file_impact.reason: New Git-object-backed lazy ticket view and typed read-receipt validation.
Carry distinct pinned code and ticket read handles through an attested gate session.
Capture tickets_oid once and install the lazy ticket view for completion execution.
Route completion context and deterministic ticket reads through the pinned view.
Make agent ticket tools resolve against the pinned view without live fallback.
Validate the receipt and publish verdict, status, and signature through one close bundle.
Add rollback-safe multi-event staging and one-commit transaction support.
Prepare a sidecar event for bundled publication rather than committing it early.
Prepare/finalize the completion certificate within the atomic close transaction contract.
New lazy-read parity, negative-read, hierarchy/link/global predicate, and cache-isolation coverage.
New fault-injection, same-ticket race, idempotence, and all-or-none close-bundle coverage.
Record the approved lazy tracker-OID read view and committed-store atomicity decision.
Document completion read basis, receipt conflicts, retry, rollout, and back-out behavior.
Document lock width, local/remote CAS behavior, and the atomic close bundle.
